lead_independence.headline: Family of Indian River Deputy's Killer Asks DeSantis for Clemency Before Oct. 20 Execution
lead_independence.lead: William Reaves is scheduled to be executed Oct. 20 for the 1986 murder of Indian River County Sheriff's Deputy Richard Raczkowski, and for the first time his family is speaking publicly to ask Gov. Ron DeSantis to spare his life. Reaves, now 77, has spent nearly four decades on death row. His nephew, Meredith Farrington, is asking DeSantis to commute the death sentence to life in prison rather than seeking a pardon or release.
